goal: Project the toolkit's canonical region/theme metadata (SpaceData.Theme, SpaceData.Regions, RegionData.Archetype, per-hex region membership via RegionAt) onto the v1alpha2 wire as Space.theme, Space.zones, and Hex.zone_id. Pure passthrough only -- no derivation of regions/archetypes/theme from geometry, no default invention. Covers both the connect-time snapshot (ProjectFor) and the incremental live GeometryRevealed event, so a hex revealed after connect also carries its zone_id.
